scripts.dev: pnpm i --ignore-workspace && concurrently -n frontend,sidecar -c blue,green "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:sidecar"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm i && pnpm dev --port 1421 --host
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm i && pnpm build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && pnpm i && pnpm lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd frontend && pnpm i && pnpm lint:fix
